placement: Next to the USB-C receptacle, CC traces short; the 330 pF capacitors at the chip.
notes: Dead battery: with no power applied the chip itself presents the sink pull-downs (Rd 5.1k, 4.6-5.6k; clamp voltage 2.18 V max) on both CC pins (p2 feature list, p16). The external 5.1k resistors must go, otherwise the two in parallel give 2.55k and the source reads a wrong termination.

VCONN: only needed to power cable electronics when acting as a source. For a sink/sniffer leave the VCONN pins unpowered; if dual-role is wanted later feed them 2.7-5.5 V (5 V for the standard) with the two capacitors. Switch limit 560 mA (p14).
It hears only its own port's CC line (all packets on it once attached); it is not an in-line sniffer for two other devices.
If it negotiates more than 5 V, VBUS rises for everything on that net: cap requests at what the BQ25895 input stage accepts.
